lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Luke, I've been with you this entire journey.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: In the neighborhood, you learned to help others. At the mall, you learned the value of connection.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: And in the store... I learned that avoidance only leads to emptiness.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Exactly. And when you helped me at Grocery Outlet, you proved you'd learned Professor Layton's lessons.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But why? Why go through all this?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Because you needed to face your fear. Not by avoiding it, but by understanding it.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Shopping isn't really what I was afraid of, was it?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: No. You were afraid of responsibility, of making decisions, of being alone.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: And Professor Layton... was he ever in danger?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lights turn on.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: I'm afraid not, my boy. This was all a rather elaborate lesson.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor! You're okay!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Of course. Though I must say, the crater was quite convincing.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: The crater... was fake?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Indeed. All part of the plan. You see, Luke, you were never meant to go shopping.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I wasn't?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: This entire day was about teaching you that life's challenges aren't about the task itself.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: They're about who you become while facing them.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: So... I don't have to do the shopping?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Oh, you already did. You bought that phone, didn't you?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I... I did! I actually did!

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: And you helped people along the way. You faced your fears. You grew.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait, who are you really?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Just someone who believes in you, Luke.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stranger smiles and walks away into the aisles.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Now then, shall we go home?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Yes. But Professor?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Yes, Luke?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Next time you want to teach me a lesson... maybe just talk to me?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Where's the fun in that?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so, Luke learned that courage isn't the absence of fear...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's doing what needs to be done despite it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The End.
